correctness.rationale: Using A=m+(1-alpha)delta>0, D=4m theta-2(1-alpha)phi, L=A(delta theta+phi)/(2theta phi)>0, U=A^2/D, existence of positive k requires D>0. Exact independent symbolic factorization confirms U-L=-(2delta theta+phi)A(m theta-(1-alpha)phi)/[2theta phi(2m theta-(1-alpha)phi)] when D>0. This yields the necessary-and-sufficient open wedge, including excluded boundaries. Independently recomputed exact L,U for four baseline pairs: (theta,phi)=(.7,.75): (2421/1750,-729/50); (.7,.9): (897/700,-729/200); (1.45,.75): (7137/7250,729/700); (1.45,.9): (2559/2900,729/550). The third assumption can only restrict further. It is a feasibility-of-reported-assumptions finding, not falsification of out-of-domain trajectories.

final_claim: For the exact printed two-sided k restriction with all positive m,theta,delta,phi and 0<alpha<1, a positive admissible k exists iff (1-alpha)*phi/2 < m*theta < (1-alpha)*phi. At the stated m=.4,alpha=.2,delta=.85 baselines this gives phi<theta<2phi, excluding the entire theta=.7 and phi in {.75,.9} branch; at theta=1.45,phi=.75 it also excludes k=1.1 and k=1.3.
